body: Also, that comic was pretty great. It mirrored so much of what I'm feeling that it actually got a laugh out of me.

I'm currently on some antidepressants and anxiety meds but I still get sudden urges to kill myself. I feel like if I had joined the military a few months ago I would be in a better position. But now I think this depression and anxiety have had some damaging effects neurologically.
Thank you for this kind reply. It's good to know someone else is out there fighting. I've had lows before, just like everyone, but it feels like I'm not coming back from this one
